chapter: Solo years, marriages and the Canadian party
title: Structure of the Garland touring show; only black performer
summary: Alan King did comedy, there were dancers, and Bubbles was the only black performer, hired through his agent.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Well, we can go on because I would imagine -- this is a touring show.
It started on Broadway and just toured around the country.
Alan King was also in it. He did comedy.
It had some chorus girls in it and chorus boys, too.
No. I was the only one.
How did they choose you? Did they go through an agent or --
